overseer-judge review [flags] <path|->

type each item and response in an overseer review round file

Output: JSON Lines, one object per item: id, severity, style_only, responses, model, usage. --pretty is rejected: a record stays on one line.

Flags:
  -dry-run
    	print the request that would be sent and exit 0
  -log-level string
    	stderr diagnostics: debug, info, warn, error (default "warn")
  -model string
    	Jev model (default from TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL)
  -pretty
    	indent JSON output
  -timeout duration
    	timeout for each HTTP attempt (default 10s)

Example:
  overseer-judge review .overseer/reviews/round-04.md |
    jq -c 'select(.style_only > 0.5)'
